info.title: review-md x-callback URL API
info.description:
Drive the review-md Obsidian plugin from other apps and agents via `obsidian://review-md-<operation>?...` URLs. Each operation is its own Obsidian action (URL endpoint) and follows the x-callback-url convention: pass `x-success`/`x-error` URLs to be opened when the operation finishes. Parameter values are URL-encoded strings. The `vault` parameter is required in the URL so Obsidian routes to the right vault window; the plugin itself resolves `file` against the active vault.

**Not an HTTP API.** These are Obsidian custom-scheme URLs; each "path" below is an Obsidian action (`obsidian://<action>`) and every parameter is passed in the query string. Invoke a URL by opening it (e.g. `open '<url>'` on macOS, or `xdg-open` on Linux). Note: Obsidian reserves `vault` (used to route to the vault window) — it is required in the URL but is not delivered to the plugin.

get.summary: Open a file in the reviewer
get.description:
Open a markdown file in the review-md reviewer and, optionally, scroll to a specific comment thread.

Invoke as: `obsidian://review-md-open?…`

Example: `obsidian://review-md-open?vault=.dev-vault&file=design.md`

parameters.name: vault
parameters.description: Name of the target Obsidian vault. Consumed by Obsidian to route to the vault window (required in the URL, but not delivered to the plugin).

parameters.name: file
parameters.description: Vault-relative path to the markdown file to open.

parameters.name: thread
parameters.description: Thread id (the file's `^blockId`) to scroll to after opening.

parameters.name: x-success
parameters.description: URL opened when the operation succeeds (x-callback-url).

parameters.name: x-error
parameters.description: URL opened when the operation fails (x-callback-url).

200.description: Success. If `x-success` was supplied, that URL is opened.

400.description: Missing or invalid parameters. If `x-error` was supplied, that URL is opened.

get.description:
Append a message to an existing comment thread stored in the file's frontmatter, then open the file at that thread.

Invoke as: `obsidian://review-md-reply?…`

Example: `obsidian://review-md-reply?vault=.dev-vault&file=design.md&thread=d1a2b3&body=agreed%20%E2%80%94%20let's%20keep%20it%20in%20frontmatter`

parameters.name: vault
parameters.description: Name of the target Obsidian vault. Consumed by Obsidian to route to the vault window (required in the URL, but not delivered to the plugin).

parameters.name: file
parameters.description: Vault-relative path to the markdown file that holds the thread.

parameters.name: thread
parameters.description: Id of the thread to reply to.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: The reply text. URL-encode newlines and special characters.
parameters.example: agreed — let's keep it in frontmatter

parameters.name: author
parameters.description: Author name recorded on the reply.

parameters.name: x-success
parameters.description: URL opened when the reply is stored (x-callback-url).

parameters.name: x-error
parameters.description: URL opened when the reply fails (x-callback-url).

200.description: Success. If `x-success` was supplied, that URL is opened.

400.description: Missing or invalid parameters. If `x-error` was supplied, that URL is opened.
